# KiCad MCP Cloud

> Secure, owner-controlled remote MCP access to selected KiCad project metadata. Project files stay on the owner's computer; client access and device access require separate authorization.

## Official product resources

- [Cloud service overview](https://kicad-mcp-pro.oaslananka.dev/): current read-only Cloud capabilities and setup workflow
- [Getting started](https://oaslananka.github.io/kicad-mcp-pro/): installation, setup, and local KiCad engineering tools
- [Cloud agent integration](https://oaslananka.github.io/kicad-mcp-pro/agents/): guidance for compatible agent hosts
- [Privacy policy](https://oaslananka.github.io/kicad-mcp-pro/privacy/): permission boundaries and data handling
- [Source repository](https://github.com/oaslananka/kicad-mcp-pro): implementation, changelog and issue tracker

## Operational boundaries

- Only clients with valid OAuth, an approved device and an explicitly granted project can read project metadata.
- Device registration does not imply a live KiCad session or permission to edit a board.
- Remote write operations are not available through the currently deployed Cloud MCP surface.
- Local KiCad editing requires separate trusted local tools and explicit approval.
